errors.erreur_inconnue: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.chargement: Loading failed. Please reload the page.
errors.serveur_injoignable: The server is not responding yet (it may be asleep). Try again in a minute.
errors.donnees_invalides: Some values are invalid. Check the fields (https:// addresses, dates, required texts).
errors.trop_de_requetes: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
errors.slug_deja_utilise: This address (slug) is already used by another project.
errors.reference_inconnue: A selected job or skill no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.nom_deja_utilise: A skill with this name already exists.
errors.ordre_incomplet: The list changed in the meantime. Reload the page before reordering.
errors.visite_avec_etapes: This tour already has steps: its type can no longer change.
errors.demo_sans_etapes: Only a guided tour can have steps.
errors.type_de_fichier_refuse: File type refused. Accepted: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM, PDF, HTML, VTT.
errors.fichier_trop_volumineux: File too large (images 5 MB, PDF 10 MB, notebooks 15 MB, videos 50 MB).
errors.contenu_de_fichier_invalide: The file content does not match its extension.
errors.media_utilise: This file is still in use (guided tour, demo, CV or proof). Remove it from there first.
errors.demande_deja_traitee: This request has already been handled.
errors.demande_non_acceptee: Only an accepted request can be revoked.
errors.deploy_hook_non_configure: Publishing is not configured (DEPLOY_HOOK_URL variable missing).
errors.deploy_hook_en_echec: The publishing service did not respond. Try again in a moment.
errors.code_invalide: This code is invalid or has expired.
errors.projet_non_confidentiel: This project is already freely available.

admin.wakingApi: Connecting to the server… (it can take a minute to wake up)

project.listDescription: The order of this list is the display order on the site. A draft is never visible to visitors.
project.publishReminder: Remember to "Update the site" (Publishing menu) so visitors see the changes.
project.previewBanner: Preview: this is the page as visitors will see it.
project.saveFirst: Save the project first to add its gallery and demos.
project.title: Title
project.slugHint: The page will be available at /projets/this-address. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
project.slugInvalid: Use only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (e.g. telcom-ci).
project.codeHint: "Confidential": the page only shows its header; the rest requires an access code.
project.featuredLabel: Featured project (shown on the home page)
project.metiersHint: The project moves up when the visitor picks one of these jobs — the higher the relevance, the higher it ranks.
project.noTechnologies: No skill exists yet. Add some in

gallery.hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, 5 MB maximum per image.
gallery.caption: Caption
gallery.removed: Image removed from the gallery (it stays in Media).

demo.created: Demo added. Fill it in below.
demo.empty: This project has no demo yet.
demo.title: Tab title (optional)
demo.titleHint: Empty: the demo type name is shown.
demo.main: Main demo (button at the top of the page)
demo.loginUrlHint: The portfolio appends "?role=role-key" to it. This route belongs to the showcased project.
demo.roleKeyHint: Value sent to the project, no spaces (e.g. passenger).

help.video: Level 2 — 60 to 90 second video, with subtitles.
help.visite: Level 3 — interactive guided tour built from screenshots.
help.notebook: Level 4 — notebook exported to HTML (jupyter nbconvert --to html).
help.playground: Level 5 — Gradio or Streamlit app (Hugging Face Spaces), shown inside the page.
help.bac_a_sable: Level 6 — deployed application with one-click sign-in per role.
help.lien_externe: Fallback demo or downloadable file (Arcade, Supademo, GitHub release…).

urlHint.video: MP4/WebM file from the library, or unlisted YouTube link.
urlHint.playground: Space address, e.g. https://space-name.hf.space. Empty: "unavailable" is shown.
urlHint.bac_a_sable: Address of the demo application: used to wake the server before sign-in.

tour.title: Guided tour editor
tour.description: Import the screenshots in journey order, draw the area to click on each one and write its caption.
tour.importHint: Select several files at once: they become steps, in the order of their names. You can also pick an already imported image.
tour.noSteps: No step yet. Start by importing the screenshots of the journey.
tour.drawHint: Draw a rectangle on the screenshot with the mouse (or a finger) to define the area to click. Without an area, the visitor moves on with "Next".
tour.zoneCoordinates: Clickable area, in % of the image
tour.caption: Caption

history.description: Each save keeps a copy of the previous state of the project (title, content, badges, jobs, technologies).
history.empty: No earlier version: the project has not been modified yet.
history.confirmRestore: Replace the current content with this version? The current state will be kept in the history.

skill.description: Each skill belongs to a domain and has a level. The site shows the projects that prove it.
skill.name: Name

timeline.description: Education, internship, certifications, hackathons and challenges: a single timeline on the About page, sorted by date.

profile.description: This information feeds the home, About and Contact pages.
profile.name: Displayed name
profile.headline: Headline

sectionHints.accroche: Two sentences, shown on the home page.
sectionHints.profil: About page: from software engineering to data.
sectionHints.orientation: About page: what you are looking for.
sectionHints.methode: About page: the way you work.

media.description: Images, videos, PDFs (CV, statements), HTML notebooks and subtitles. File names are regenerated on import.
media.limits: Images 5 MB · PDF 10 MB · notebooks 15 MB · videos 50 MB.

messages.description: Messages received through the contact form. A notification is also sent by email.

access.description: Access requests for confidential projects. Accepting sends the visitor a code valid for 7 days.
access.confirmRevoke: Revoke this code? The visitor will no longer be able to view the project.
access.accepted: Request accepted: the code has been emailed.
access.refused: Request refused: the visitor is notified by email.
access.noConsultation: This code has not been used yet.
access.codeNotice: This code has just been emailed to the visitor. It is shown only once: only its fingerprint is stored.

publication.explanation: The public site is made of pages generated in advance: it displays even when the server is asleep. After publishing or editing content, click here to regenerate those pages.
publication.scope: Only projects with the "Published" status are included. The update takes one to two minutes.
publication.done: Update started. In a minute or two, check the result at
